note: docs/protocol.md section 10, machine-readable. This file is the arbiter between the Python table in src/negotiation_protocol/reasons.py and the TypeScript table in src/index.ts: both are checked against it, so a code added in one language alone fails the build. The codes are on-chain — a participant signs Close.reason and the operator passes abortSession(reason) — and the contract reverts on anything undefined, so an addition here is a protocol change.

close_reasons.name: terms_unacceptable
close_reasons.meaning: Agent judges the terms outside what it will accept

close_reasons.name: inventory_constraint
close_reasons.meaning: Agent cites its inventory floor or balance

abort_reasons.name: model_failure
abort_reasons.meaning: Model exhausted repair or timed out or refused

abort_reasons.name: execution_failure
abort_reasons.meaning: Settlement or other required transaction reverted and cannot proceed
